## Bathymetry of Study Area - SNE
```{r}
library(ncdf4)
library(raster)

# Load
file <- "path\\gebco_2024_n41.23_s40.76_w-71.91_e-70.64.tif"
r <- raster(file)

# Define box bounds
extent_box <- extent(-71.91, -70.64, 40.76, 41.23)  # lon_min, lon_max, lat_min, lat_max
r_crop <- crop(r, extent_box)

# Remove land
r_ocean <- mask(r_crop, r_crop < 0, maskvalue = FALSE)

# Average ocean depth
mean_depth <- cellStats(r_ocean, stat = 'mean', na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Average ocean depth: %.2f meters\n", mean_depth))

#Range
range_depth <- cellStats(r_ocean, stat = 'range', na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Range of ocean depth: %.2f meters\n", range_depth))

```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(tidyr)
library(DescTools)
library(boot)

# Set the folder path containing the CSV files
folder_path <- "path"

# Get the list of CSV files in the folder
csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize an empty data frame to store combined results
combined_data <- data.frame()

# Loop through each CSV file
for (file_path in csv_files) {
  data <- read_csv(file_path, col_names = TRUE, col_types = cols(
    State = col_character(),  
    Period = col_factor(levels = c("Day", "Night")),
    Duration = col_double()
  )) %>%
    select(State, Period, Duration)

  # Remove rows with NA values
  data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(State) & !is.na(Period) & !is.na(Duration))

  # Combine the data
  combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data, data)
}

# Ensure 'Period' and 'State' are factors for correct grouping
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = c("Day", "Night")),
         State = factor(State, levels = c("F", "EF", "T", "R", "SU", "S")))

# Replace state labels for clarity
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(State = recode(State,
                        "F" = "Feeding",
                        "EF" = "Exploratory Foraging",
                        "T" = "Traveling",
                        "R" = "Resting",
                        "SU" = "Surface",
                        "S" = "Unknown"))

# Calculate the total duration spent in each state within each period
proportions <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(Period, State) %>%
  summarise(Total_Duration = sum(Duration), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Total_Duration / sum(Total_Duration),
         Percentage = Proportion * 100,
         Display_Label = ifelse(Percentage < 1, "*", paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%"))) %>%
  select(Period, State, Proportion, Percentage, Display_Label)

# Create a bar graph to show proportions based on duration
ggplot(proportions, aes(x = Period, y = Proportion, fill = State)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black", size = 1) +  
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Behavioral State Diel Trends",
    x = "Period",
    y = "Proportion of Total Duration",
    fill = "Behavioral State"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),                  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),               
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),                
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Display_Label),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white",
    size = 4
  ) 

# Create a contingency table
contingency_table <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(Period, State) %>%
  summarise(State_Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  spread(key = Period, value = State_Count, fill = 0)

# Transpose to match expected format
chi_table <- as.table(as.matrix(contingency_table[, c("Day", "Night")]))
rownames(chi_table) <- contingency_table$State

# Chi-square test
chi_square_result <- chisq.test(chi_table)
print(chi_square_result)

# Cramer's V (effect size)
cramers_v <- CramerV(chi_table)
cat("Cramer's V:", cramers_v, "\n")

# Bootstrapping Cramer's V confidence interval
bootstrap_cramersv <- function(data, indices) {
  sampled_data <- data[indices, ]
  tbl <- table(sampled_data$Period, sampled_data$State)
  return(CramerV(tbl))
}

boot_result <- boot(combined_data, statistic = bootstrap_cramersv, R = 1000)
ci_cramersv <- boot.ci(boot_result, type = "perc")

cat("95% CI for Cramer's V:", ci_cramersv$percent[4:5], "\n")

# Total counts by period (needed for CI calculation)
total_counts <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  summarise(Total = n())

# Pairwise tests with confidence intervals
pairwise_results <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  do({
    state_data <- .
    tbl <- table(state_data$Period)
    
    # If both Day and Night are present, do the test
    if (all(c("Day", "Night") %in% names(tbl))) {
      total_day <- total_counts$Total[total_counts$Period == "Day"]
      total_night <- total_counts$Total[total_counts$Period == "Night"]
      
      count_day <- tbl["Day"]
      count_night <- tbl["Night"]
      
      test_result <- prop.test(x = c(count_day, count_night),
                               n = c(total_day, total_night),
                               correct = FALSE)
      
      data.frame(State = unique(state_data$State),
                 X_squared = test_result$statistic,
                 p_value = test_result$p.value,
                 CI_low_Day = test_result$conf.int[1],
                 CI_high_Day = test_result$conf.int[2])
    } else {
      data.frame(State = unique(state_data$State),
                 X_squared = NA,
                 p_value = NA,
                 CI_low_Day = NA,
                 CI_high_Day = NA)
    }
  })

# Bonferroni adjustment
pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(Adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni"))

print(pairwise_results)
```

# Mixed Effects Model - State and Depth
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(lmerTest)
library(afex)
library(easystats)
library(MuMIn)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(AICcmodavg)

# Load all CSV files from the folder
folder_path <- "path"
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read and combine all files, ensuring proper column types
all_data <- lapply(file_list, function(file) {
  data <- read_csv(file, col_types = cols(State = col_character()))
  data <- mutate_all(data, as.character)
  data$Individual <- basename(file)  # Use file name as individual identifier
  
  # Remove the first two rows from the data
  data <- slice(data, -c(1, 2))  # Removes first and second rows

  # Add "group" prefix to the basename
  data$GroupID <- paste0("group", basename(file))
  return(data)
})

# Combine all data frames into a single data frame
data <- bind_rows(all_data)

#Data Preparation
# Ensure 'Period' is treated as a factor (Day, Night, Twilight)
data$Period <- factor(data$Period, levels = c("Day", "Night"))
data$State <- factor(data$State, levels = c('F', 'EF', 'S', 'SU', 'T', 'R'))
data$Dive_Max = as.numeric(data$Dive_Max)

# Remove "SU" from the State column
data <- data %>%
  filter(State != "SU")

# Set same Individuals
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Individual = case_when(
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp23_205a_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp23_213c_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "match1",
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp23_205d_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp23_206b_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "match2",
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp23_206c_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp23_206f_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "match3",
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp23_212a_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp23_212c_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "match4",
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp24_205b_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp24_205c_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp24_207a_states_datetime.csv") ~ "match5",
    TRUE ~ as.factor(Individual)
  ))

# Set Pairs
data <- data %>%
  mutate(GroupID = case_when(
    GroupID %in% c("groupsun_bp23_205c_divestates_datetime.csv", "groupsun_bp23_205d_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "group1",
    GroupID %in% c("groupsun_bp23_213a_divestates_datetime.csv", "groupsun_bp23_213b_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "group2",
    GroupID %in% c("groupsun_bp24_204a_divestates_datetime.csv", "groupsun_bp24_204b_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "group3",
    GroupID %in% c("groupsun_bp24_207a_divestates_datetime.csv", "groupsun_bp24_207b_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "group4",
    TRUE ~ as.factor(GroupID)
  ))

#Fit mixed-effects models for each state using the adjusted duration
model_depth <- lmer(Dive_Max ~ State + (1 | Individual) + (1 | GroupID), data = data)
summary(model_depth)
anova(model_depth)

# homogeneity of variances
plot(model_depth)

### log transformation
# log(x+1) transformation
data <- mutate(data, log_Dive_Max = log(Dive_Max + 1))

logmodel_depth <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ State + (1 | Individual) + (1 | GroupID), data = data)
summary(logmodel_depth)
anova (logmodel_depth)
plot(logmodel_depth) #homogeneity of variance is better!

# normality of the residuals
qqnorm(residuals(model_depth))

qqnorm(residuals(logmodel_depth))

# effect size
omega_squared(logmodel_depth)

#RSquared
r.squaredGLMM(logmodel_depth)

#confidence intervals
confint(logmodel_depth, method = "profile")

#AIC comparison
# Null model (only random effects)
null_model <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ 1 + (1 | Individual) + (1 | GroupID), data = data)

# Model with no GroupID
model_no_group <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ State + (1 | Individual), data = data)

# Model with no Individual
model_no_indiv <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ State + (1 | GroupID), data = data)

#full model
logmodel_depth <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ State + (1 | Individual) + (1 | GroupID), data = data)

AIC(null_model, model_no_group, model_no_indiv, logmodel_depth)

aictab(list(null_model, model_no_group, model_no_state, logmodel_depth),
       modnames = c("Null", "No Group", "No Indiv", "Full Model"))

#Use afex to plot stats
afexplotdur <- afex_plot(logmodel_depth, 
                         x = "State", 
                         id = "Individual", 
                         dodge = 0.4, 
                         point_arg = list(size = 5, pch = 21), 
                         factor_levels = list(State = c("Feeding", "Exploratory Foraging", "Unknown", "Travel","Rest"))) + 
  labs(y = "log(depth + 1)", x = "State", face = "bold") +
  theme_pubr(14, x.text.angle = 45) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Manually modify the plot to ensure 'State' is mapped to fill
afexplotdur <- afexplotdur + 
  aes(fill = State) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Feeding" = "#440154FF", "Exploratory Foraging" = "#414487FF", "Travel" = "#2A788EFF","Rest" = "#22A884FF", "Unknown" = "#ffcf20FF"), name = "State") 

# Print the plot
print(afexplotdur)

# Get model means and confidence intervals
afex1 <- afex_plot(logmodel_depth, x = "State", id = "Individual", return = "data")
#Back transform
exp(afex1$means$y) - 1
#[1]41.128563 26.607531 14.768882  8.350878  7.444541
exp(afex1$means$lower.CL) - 1
#32.095676 20.628333 10.453745  6.327463  5.622940
exp(afex1$means$upper.CL) - 1
#52.626817 34.239690 20.709722 10.933043  9.767161
```

# Mixed Effects Model - Period and Depth
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(lmerTest)
library(afex)
library(easystats)
library(MuMIn)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)

# Load all CSV files from the folder
folder_path <- "path"
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read and combine all files, ensuring proper column types
all_data <- lapply(file_list, function(file) {
  data <- read_csv(file, col_types = cols(State = col_character()))
  data <- mutate_all(data, as.character)  # Convert all columns to character
  data$Individual <- basename(file)  # Use file name as individual identifier
  
  # Remove the first two rows from the data
  data <- slice(data, -c(1, 2))  # Removes first and second rows

  # Add "group" prefix to the basename
  data$GroupID <- paste0("group", basename(file))
  return(data)
})

# Combine all data frames into a single data frame
data <- bind_rows(all_data)

#Data Preparation
# Ensure 'Period' is treated as a factor (Day, Night, Twilight)
data$Period <- factor(data$Period, levels = c("Day", "Night"))
data$State <- factor(data$State, levels = c('F', 'EF', 'S', 'SU', 'T', 'R'))
data$Dive_Max = as.numeric(data$Dive_Max)

data <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Period))

# Set same Individuals
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Individual = case_when(
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp23_205a_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp23_213c_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "match1",
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp23_205d_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp23_206b_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "match2",
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp23_206c_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp23_206f_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "match3",
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp23_212a_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp23_212c_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "match4",
    Individual %in% c("sun_bp24_205b_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp24_205c_divestates_datetime.csv", "sun_bp24_207a_states_datetime.csv") ~ "match5",
    TRUE ~ as.factor(Individual)
  ))

# Set Pairs
data <- data %>%
  mutate(GroupID = case_when(
    GroupID %in% c("groupsun_bp23_205c_divestates_datetime.csv", "groupsun_bp23_205d_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "group1",
    GroupID %in% c("groupsun_bp23_213a_divestates_datetime.csv", "groupsun_bp23_213b_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "group2",
    GroupID %in% c("groupsun_bp24_204a_divestates_datetime.csv", "groupsun_bp24_204b_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "group3",
    GroupID %in% c("groupsun_bp24_207a_divestates_datetime.csv", "groupsun_bp24_207b_divestates_datetime.csv") ~ "group4",
    TRUE ~ as.factor(GroupID)
  ))

#Fit mixed-effects models for each state using the adjusted duration
model_depth2 <- lmer(Dive_Max ~ Period + (1 | Individual) + (1 | GroupID), data = data)
summary(model_depth2)
anova(model_depth2)

# homogeneity of variances
plot(model_depth2)

### log transformation
# log(x+1) transformation
data <- mutate(data, log_Dive_Max = log(Dive_Max + 1))

logmodel_depth2 <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ Period + (1 | Individual) + (1 | GroupID), data = data)
summary(logmodel_depth2)
anova (logmodel_depth2)
plot(logmodel_depth2) #homogeneity of variance is better!

# normality of the residuals
qqnorm(residuals(model_depth2))

qqnorm(residuals(logmodel_depth2))

# effect size
omega_squared(logmodel_depth2)

#RSquared
r.squaredGLMM(logmodel_depth2)

#confidence intervals
confint(logmodel_depth2, method = "profile")

#AIC comparison
# Null model — only random effects
null_model2 <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ 1 + (1 | Individual) + (1 | GroupID), data = data)

# Random effects with fixed effect Period
logmodel_depth2 <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ Period + (1 | Individual) + (1 | GroupID), data = data)

# Group removed
model_no_group2 <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ Period + (1 | Individual), data = data)

# Individual removed
model_no_indiv2 <- lmer(log_Dive_Max ~ Period + (1 | GroupID), data = data)

AIC(null_model2, model_no_group2, model_no_indiv2, logmodel_depth2, extra)

model_list2 <- list(
  Null = null_model2,
  NoGroup = model_no_group2,
  NoIndividual = model_no_indiv2,
  FullModel = logmodel_depth2
)

aictab(model_list2, sort = TRUE)

#Use afex to plot stats
afexplotdepth <- afex_plot(logmodel_depth2, 
                         x = "Period", 
                         id = "Individual", 
                         dodge = 0.4, 
                         point_arg = list(size = 5, pch = 21), 
                         factor_levels = list(State = c("Day","Night"))) + 
  labs(y = "log(depth + 1)", x = "Period", face = "bold") +
  theme_pubr(14, x.text.angle = 45) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

afexplotdepth <- afexplotdepth + 
  aes(fill = Period, color = Period) +  # Map both fill and color to 'Period'
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Day" = "white", "Night" = "grey"), name = "Period") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Day" = "black", "Night" = "black"))

# Print the plot
print(afexplotdepth)

# Get model means and confidence intervals
afex1 <- afex_plot(logmodel_depth2, x = "Period", id = "Individual", return = "data")
#Back transform
exp(afex1$means$y) - 1
#[1] 8.383134 5.550364
```

#Time spent at depth
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(viridis)

folder_path <- "path/depth bins"

# Helper: read one CSV and add an ID column 
read_depth_csv <- function(fp) {
  read.csv(fp, header = TRUE) |>
    select(Depth_Lower, Depth_Upper, Time_Spent_sec) |>
    mutate(ID = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fp)))
}

# Combine files
combined_data <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) |>
  map_dfr(read_depth_csv)

#set individuals
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(ID = case_when(
    ID %in% c("bp23_205a_depthtimes", "bp23_213c_depthtimes") ~ "match1",
    ID %in% c("bp23_205d_depthtimes", "bp23_206b_depthtimes") ~ "match2",
    ID %in% c("bp23_206c_depthtimes", "bp23_206f_depthtimes") ~ "match3",
    ID %in% c("bp23_212a_depthtimes", "bp23_212c_depthtimes") ~ "match4",
    ID %in% c("bp24_205b_depthtimes", "bp24_205c_depthtimes", "bp24_207a_depthtimes") ~ "match5",
    TRUE ~ as.factor(ID)
  ))

# Per‑individual proportions
indiv_summary <- combined_data |>
  group_by(ID, Depth_Lower, Depth_Upper) |>
  summarise(Total_Time_Spent = sum(Time_Spent_sec), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(ID) |>
  mutate(Proportion = Total_Time_Spent / sum(Total_Time_Spent)) |>
  ungroup()

indiv_summary <- indiv_summary %>%
  mutate(region = case_when(
    ID %in% c("bp24_209a_depthtimes", "bp24_209d_depthtimes", "bp24_210a_depthtimes", "bp24_210d_depthtimes") ~ "Individual (New York Bight)",
    TRUE ~ "Individual (Southern New England)"
  ))

# Overall proportions (all IDs pooled)
overall_summary <- combined_data |>
  group_by(Depth_Lower, Depth_Upper) |>
  summarise(Total_Time_Spent = sum(Time_Spent_sec), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(ID = "Overall",
         Proportion = Total_Time_Spent / sum(Total_Time_Spent))

# Combine data
plot_data <- bind_rows(indiv_summary, overall_summary) |>
  mutate(across(c(Depth_Lower, Depth_Upper), ~ -.x))

# Plot
plot_data %>%
  mutate(Line = if_else(ID == "Overall", "Overall", "Individual"),
         Colour_Group = case_when(
           ID == "Overall" ~ "Overall",
           region == "Individual (Southern New England)" ~ "Individual (Southern New England)",
           region == "Individual (New York Bight)" ~ "Individual (New York Bight)"
         )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Depth_Lower,
    y = Proportion,
    colour = Colour_Group,
    alpha = Line,
    group = ID
  )) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
  values = c(
    "Overall" = "black",
    "Individual (Southern New England)" = "#22A884FF",
    "Individual (New York Bight)" = "#ffcf20FF"
  )
) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(Overall = 1, Individual = 0.35)) +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Depth (m)",
    y = "Proportion of Total Time",
    colour = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
  axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.position = c(0.5, 0.8),
  legend.justification = c(0, 1),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha('white', 0.7))
)

```

#Map of GPS and AIS with windfarm development
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(viridis)
library(mapview)
library(sf) 
library(htmlwidgets)
library(terra)

#Read 2023 data
csv_2023 <- list.files(
  path = "path",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

data_2023 <- map_dfr(csv_2023, ~read_csv(.x) %>% mutate(source = basename(.x)))

# Add manual 2023 locations
manual_2023 <- tibble(
  Longitude = c(-70.7326, -70.8007, -70.8011, -70.8357, -70.766128),
  Latitude = c(41.08056, 41.06859, 41.09212, 41.10371, 41.092221),
  source = c("bp23_205d", "bp23_207b", "bp23_207c", "bp23_212a", "bp23_213c")
)

data_2023 <- bind_rows(data_2023, manual_2023)

#Read 2024 data
csv_2024 <- list.files(
  path = "path",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

data_2024 <- map_dfr(csv_2024, ~read_csv(.x, col_names = FALSE) %>% mutate(source = basename(.x)))
data_2024 <- data_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Latitude = X5,
    Longitude = X6
  )

# Add manual 2024 locations
manual_2024 <- tibble(
  Longitude = c(-71.913, -73.146203),
  Latitude = c(40.867, 39.883242),
  source = c("bp24_205d", "bp24_209d")
)

data_2024 <- bind_rows(data_2024, manual_2024)

# --- Combine all data ---
all_data <- bind_rows(data_2023, data_2024) %>%
  arrange(source)

all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Longitude = as.numeric(Longitude),
    Latitude = as.numeric(Latitude)
  )

all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(region = case_when(
    source %in% c("bp24_209a_0198609_240727151641.csv", "bp24_209d", "bp24_210a_0198613_240728160424.csv", "bp24_210d_0198614_240729000859.csv") ~ "New York Bight",
    TRUE ~ "Southern New England"
  ))

# Generate colors by source
source_colors <- c("Southern New England" = "#22A884FF",
    "New York Bight" = "#ffcf20FF")

# Load rasters
r1 <- rast("C:\\Users\\dladcock\\OneDrive - Syracuse University\\Documents\\ArcGIS\\Projects\\MyProject2\\TankerVesselTransit.tif")
r2 <- rast("C:\\Users\\dladcock\\OneDrive - Syracuse University\\Documents\\ArcGIS\\Projects\\MyProject2\\CargoVesselTransit.tif")

r1[r1 == 0] <- NA  # or some threshold to mask low-count areas
r2[r2 == 0] <- NA  # or some threshold to mask low-count areas

#downsample
r1_small <- aggregate(r1, fact = 2, fun = mean)
r1_proj <- project(r1_small, "EPSG:3857")

r2_small <- aggregate(r2, fact = 2, fun = mean)
r2_proj <- project(r2_small, "EPSG:3857")

# Combine min/max for a shared color scale
combined_range <- range(c(values(r1_proj), values(r2_proj)), na.rm = TRUE)

# Define a common palette
shared_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = viridis(256),
  domain = combined_range,
  na.color = "transparent"
)

shapefile_path <- "path\\offshorewindoutlines.shp"
shape_data <- st_read(shapefile_path)

# Transform to WGS84 (longitude/latitude)
shape_data <- st_transform(shape_data, crs = 4326)

sources <- unique(all_data$source)

# Initialize map
m <- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "topright", 
              options = scaleBarOptions(maxWidth = 200,imperial = FALSE))%>%
  addPolygons(
    data = shape_data,
    color = "black",
    weight = 2,
    fillOpacity = 0.2,
    group = "Shapefile Layer") %>%

  # Add both rasters with the shared palette
  addRasterImage(r1_proj, colors = shared_pal, opacity = 0.6, group = "Vessel Count A") %>%
  addRasterImage(r2_proj, colors = shared_pal, opacity = 0.6, group = "Vessel Count B") %>%
  addLegend(pal = shared_pal, values = combined_range, title = "Vessel Transit Count") 
sources <- unique(all_data$source)

for (s in sources) {
  df <- all_data %>% filter(source == s)
  region_label <- df$region[1]
  color <- source_colors[[region_label]]

  m <- m %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = df,
      lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude,
      label = ~paste("Region:", region),
      color = color,
      radius = 4,
      fillOpacity = 1,
      stroke = FALSE,
      group = s
    ) %>%
    addPolylines(
      data = df,
      lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude,
      color = color,
      weight = 4,
      opacity = 0.9,
      group = s
    )
}
```
